Follow-up needed to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures and the orchestrator error during rollback before re-attempting the release.

trace.final:
Task complete. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Diagnosis**
- checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.

**Remediation**
1. Initiated a rollback to v2.3.0 — it **partially failed**: only us-east rolled back before the orchestrator halted with an error, leaving us-west and eu-west on the unhealthy v2.3.1.
2. Since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production, I ran a full deploy of v2.3.0 to all regions.
3. Verified: all three regions now run **v2.3.0**, service is **healthy**, error rate is back down to **~0.2%**.

**Incident**
- Opened a SEV2 incident for checkout-api describing the failure and the remediation steps taken; the on-call engineer has been paged.

**One caveat:** The first incident creation request timed out but had actually succeeded (INC-0001), and my retry created a duplicate (INC-0002). I don't have a tool to close or merge incidents, so **both INC-0001 and INC-0002 are currently open** — please have someone close INC-0002 as a duplicate.

**Recommended follow-ups** (noted in the incident): investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures and the orchestrator error that stalled the initial rollback before re-attempting the release.
